question: How do I create a kMeet meeting?
ground_truth: To create a kMeet meeting: 1) Start kMeet via kmeet.infomaniak.com or from the desktop/mobile app. 2) Start a new meeting. 3) Enter a name for your meeting room. 4) Allow access to webcam and microphone. 5) Enter your name or pseudonym. 6) Optionally enable participant control, password, or encryption. 7) Click 'Join the meeting'. 8) Share the room link to invite participants.
answer:
To create a kMeet meeting, follow these steps:

1. Start kMeet via [kmeet.infomaniak.com](https://kmeet.infomaniak.com) or from one of the applications for computers or mobile devices.
2. Start a new meeting.
3. Enter a name for your meeting room.
4. Click on the security options.
5. Enable the toggle switch to Protect access.
6. Create the password.
7. Continue to start the meeting.
8. Specify the name you want to use as a participant in the meeting.
9. Share the meeting link or code and the password with your participants.

For more details, refer to the [Infomaniak documentation on securing a kMeet meeting](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2464/secure-a-kmeet-meeting-with-a-password-and-encryption-key).

question: How can I share my screen during a kMeet call?
ground_truth: To share your screen in kMeet: 1) Have the desktop app (macOS/Windows) or mobile app (Android) - screen sharing is not yet available on iOS. 2) Create or join a meeting. 3) Click on the screen icon with an arrow to 'Share your screen'. 4) Validate authorization to access screen content. 5) Choose to share the entire screen or a specific window. 6) Click button to start sharing. 7) To stop, click the toolbar icon again. Note: Permissions may require a restart on first use.
key_points: choose entire screen or specific window
answer:
To share your screen during a kMeet call, follow these steps:

1. **Start the kMeet app** and [create](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2475) or [join](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2473) a meeting room.
2. **Initiate a screen share** by clicking on the screen share icon in the toolbar. This feature is available on the desktop app (macOS / Windows / Linux) and the web app (kmeet.infomaniak.com). Note that screen sharing is not yet possible with the mobile iOS app.
3. **Select the screen or window** you want to share. You can share your entire screen or just a specific application window.

For more details, refer to the official guide: [Share your screen on kMeet](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2477/share-your-screen-on-kmeet).

question: What should I do if my audio is not working in kMeet?
ground_truth: To fix audio issues in kMeet: 1) Go to kMeet Settings and reauthorize microphone access. 2) Check browser lock icon isn't blocking multimedia. 3) On mobile, check Settings > Privacy > Microphone permissions for kMeet. 4) On Windows, use Privacy settings and Audio Troubleshooter. 5) Try joining from a different device (mobile instead of computer or vice versa). 6) As last resort on Firefox, disable WebRTC in about:config by setting media.peerconnection.enabled to false.
answer:
To resolve audio issues in kMeet, follow these steps:

- **Check your device settings**:
  - Ensure your microphone is not muted.
  - Verify that the correct audio input device is selected in kMeet's settings.

- **Browser and connection troubleshooting**:
  - Ensure you are using a supported browser (Chrome, Firefox, Edge, or Safari).
  - Check your internet connection and consider switching from WiFi to 4G/5G to bypass potential firewall issues.

- **Firewall and network settings**:
  - Allow UDP Protocol on port `443`.
  - For the turn server, add TCP port `443`.
  - Allow the following IP addresses: `185.125.24.0/24` (TCP/UDP).

- **Restart and update**:
  - Restart your device and browser.
  - Ensure your browser and operating system are up to date.

For more detailed instructions, refer to the [Infomaniak support page on solving audio problems in kMeet](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2441). If the issue persists, contact Infomaniak support for further assistance.

question: How can I record a kMeet meeting?
ground_truth: To record a kMeet meeting: Prerequisites: Have a kDrive, be the moderator, and don't use encrypted meeting with custom key. Steps: 1) Start kMeet. 2) Once in the meeting, click on the action menu (three dots). 3) Click 'Start recording'. 4) Log in to Infomaniak if needed and select a kDrive for storage. 5) To stop, click the toolbar again and choose 'Stop recording'. 6) The recording is saved to the kDrive root in .mp4 format when all participants leave. Maximum duration is 3 hours.
answer:
To record a kMeet meeting, follow these steps:

1. **Start kMeet**:
   - Go to [kmeet.infomaniak.com](https://kmeet.infomaniak.com) or use the kMeet app on your computer or mobile device.

2. **Access the Action Menu**:
   - Once in the meeting, click on the action menu (○○○) in the kMeet toolbar.

3. **Start Recording**:
   - Click on the icon (◉ Start recording).

4. **Confirm and Select kDrive**:
   - Confirm the operation and log in to your Infomaniak account if prompted.
   - Select a kDrive to save the recording and click the button to start.

5. **Stop Recording**:
   - To stop recording, click on the toolbar again and choose **Stop recording**.

6. **Confirm and Access Recording**:
   - Confirm the stop recording action.
   - Choose whether to go to the recording location on kDrive.

7. **Access the Recording**:
   - The recording will be available at the root of the chosen kDrive as soon as the virtual room is closed (i.e., when all participants have left the video conference).

For more details, refer to the [Infomaniak documentation on saving a kMeet meeting on kDrive](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2472/save-a-kmeet-meeting-on-kdrive).

question: How do I set a password for my kMeet meeting?

question: How do I install kDrive on Linux?
ground_truth: To install kDrive on Linux: Prerequisites: Download the kDrive .AppImage file, install libfuse2 (required for Ubuntu 23.04+: sudo apt install libfuse2), D-Bus, and gnome-keyring or kwallet. Steps: 1) Place the .AppImage file in an 'Applications' folder. 2) Right-click the file and select 'Permissions'. 3) Check 'Allow executing file as a program'. Note: Officially supported on Ubuntu 22.04 LTS+ with GNOME or KDE. Lite Sync and right-click context menu not available on Linux. For Ubuntu startup, add to 'Startup Application Preferences'. For GNOME icon, install AppIndicator extension.
key_points: Lite Sync not available on Linux
answer:
To install the kDrive app on Linux, follow these steps:

1. Download the kDrive application for Linux from the official Infomaniak website.
2. Open the downloaded application to start the installation on your device.
3. At the end of the installation, the application should open and a form will ask you to log in to your Infomaniak account.
4. Then, choose from the list the kDrive you want to synchronize (if your account allows access to multiple kDrives).
5. Enable or disable the Lite Sync option (feature of the Windows and macOS app that saves space by virtually storing your kDrive files on your computer, only downloading them when necessary).
6. A kDrive folder is created on your hard drive at the indicated location (a location that is recommended not to be modified, but if necessary you can do so by clicking on the pencil icon ✎).
7. During installation, pay attention to the permissions that may be requested (especially on macOS) and that must be granted for the proper functioning of the application.

Source: [Sync kDrive across different devices](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2374/sync-kdrive-across-different-devices)

question: How can I share a file from kDrive?
ground_truth: To share a file/folder in kDrive: 1) Access kDrive web app at ksuite.infomaniak.com/kdrive. 2) Right-click on the file/folder. 3) Click 'Share...' at the top of the menu. Options: a) Activate a public share link (with options for modification, expiration date, password, download authorization). b) Or enter a kDrive user, contact email, or work team. For each person, define rights: 'viewing', 'modification', or 'management'. Recipients without Infomaniak account can create one free. Warning: deactivating/reactivating public link changes the URL.
key_points: recipients can create free Infomaniak account
answer:
To share a file from kDrive, follow these steps:

1. Click [here](https://ksuite.infomaniak.com/kdrive) to access the kDrive web app.
2. Right-click on the file or folder you want to share.
3. Click on **Share**... at the top of the dropdown menu.

From there, you can:

- Activate a **public share link** with various options:
  - Authorization to modify the document if it is in a collaborative format.
  - Expiration date.
  - Password protection.
  - Download authorization.
  - Access authorization so that the user with access to the share link can request full access.

- Enter a kDrive user, a contact from your address book, the email address of a new contact, or a [work team](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2585) if the sharing is done within the “common folders”.

For detailed instructions, refer to the [kDrive documentation](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2382/share-data-from-the-kdrive-web-app).

question: What is a Drop Box in kDrive and how do I create one?
ground_truth: A Drop Box in kDrive lets you invite contacts to deposit files/folders directly into your kDrive. To create: 1) Access kDrive at ksuite.infomaniak.com/kdrive. 2) Navigate to the folder that will host the data (personal or shared). 3) Click the blue 'New' button. 4) Click 'Drop Box'. 5) Enter a name. 6) Choose access settings. 7) Click 'Create'. 8) Share the link with contacts. Advanced options: email notification on deposit, password protection, expiration date, storage limit. To disable: go to Shares > Drop boxes, right-click and select 'Disable' (converts to regular folder).
key_points: can set password, expiration, storage limit
answer:
A Drop Box in kDrive is a shared space that allows others to upload files to your kDrive without requiring them to have a kDrive account or access to your files. It's a convenient way to collect files from multiple people.

To create a Drop Box in kDrive, follow these steps:

1. Log in to your kDrive account.
2. Navigate to the folder where you want to create the Drop Box.
3. Click on the "New" button and select "Drop Box" from the dropdown menu.
4. Give your Drop Box a name and set the desired permissions (e.g., who can upload files).
5. Click on "Create" to finalize the Drop Box.

For more detailed instructions, you can refer to the official kDrive documentation on managing shared folders [here](https://infomaniak.kayako.com/en/article Managing-Shared-Folders).

question: How do I resolve sync conflicts in kDrive?
ground_truth: Sync conflicts occur when: a file is modified locally AND on kDrive Web simultaneously, or during conflicting create/move operations. Resolution: kDrive Web version is kept, local version is saved as '[filename]_conflict'. Options: 1) Keep both (only original syncs). 2) Delete _conflict if it's older. 3) Delete original and rename _conflict to sync it. 4) Manually merge then delete _conflict. To view conflicts: click kDrive icon > info button > view events. From version 3.6.11, locally modified files are moved to 'kDrive Rescue Folder' instead of deleted. Avoid conflicts by not working on the same file with multiple people.
key_points: conflicts when same file modified locally and online
can keep both, delete, or merge
answer:
To resolve sync conflicts in kDrive, follow these steps:

1. **Display Conflicts**:
   - Click on the **kDrive** icon in your computer's notification area.
   - Click on the **information button** at the top.
   - Click on the listed event to view its details.

2. **Resolve Conflicts**:
   - Choose how to resolve the conflict by deciding to send the local version to the server (synchronize) or to the computer's recycle bin.

3. **Avoid Future Conflicts**:
   - Do not work on the same file with multiple people unless you are working online on a Word, Excel, or PowerPoint document.
   - Synchronize your offline modifications before modifying the same files online.
   - Avoid creating folders that have the same name as folders you do not synchronize on a device.

For more detailed instructions, refer to the [kDrive documentation](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2403/resolve-a-kdrive-synchronization-conflict).

question: How do I manage user rights in kDrive?
ground_truth: kDrive has 2 permission levels: 1) Administrator - same rights as owner (sharing, statistics, restore/delete folders, import data, access all files). 2) User - access folders at root, create/share content, but cannot manage product, view statistics, or create root folders. To modify: 1) Go to ksuite.infomaniak.com/kdrive. 2) Click action menu next to the kDrive. 3) Click 'Manage users'. 4) Select user and choose access level. Note: Don't confuse Manager rights (product management) with kDrive rights (data access). A user can have restricted Manager rights but be Administrator in kDrive.
key_points: don't confuse Manager rights with kDrive rights
answer:
To manage user rights in kDrive, follow these steps:

1. **Access kDrive**:
   - [Click here](https://ksuite.infomaniak.com/kdrive) to access the Infomaniak kDrive Web app.

2. **Select the Relevant kDrive**:
   - Check or select the relevant kDrive in the dropdown menu of the left sidebar.

3. **Open the Action Menu**:
   - Click on the action menu ⋮ located to the right of the relevant item.

4. **Manage Users**:
   - Click on **Manage users**.

5. **Modify User Rights**:
   - Manage the desired user's rights by choosing the desired access level:
     - **Technical**: Allows the user to manage the kDrive product and access technical details.
     - **Statistics**: Allows the user to view statistics related to kDrive usage.

6. **Save Changes**:
   - Save the modifications to update the user's rights.

### Troubleshooting

If a modification is not possible, you need to act on the user's rights at the Organization level:
- Reduce their role as an administrator by giving them a user role.

### Other Actions on the User

If necessary, open the action menu ⋮ of the desired user for advanced actions:
- Manage the user
- View their activity
- Block their access
- Remove them from kDrive

For more detailed instructions, refer to the [Infomaniak documentation](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2365/manage-a-kdrive-users-rights).

question: How can I access kDrive files locally without downloading them?
ground_truth: To access kDrive files locally: 1) Install the kDrive desktop app. 2) Click on the kDrive icon in notification area (top right macOS, bottom right Windows, double-click on Linux). 3) Click action menu at top right. 4) Choose 'Open kDrive Web' to access server files. 5) Or click the item above to open the local folder. Files can be physically present or virtually present (if Lite Sync is enabled). Lite Sync allows files to appear locally without taking up disk space - they download on demand when opened.
key_points: Open kDrive Web for server files
answer:
To access kDrive files locally without downloading them, you can use the kDrive desktop app. Here’s how:

- **Install the kDrive desktop app** on your device. Follow the instructions for [macOS](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2374), [Windows](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2374), or [Linux](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/617/install-kdrive-on-linux).
- **Launch the kDrive app** and left-click on the app icon in the notification area of your computer.
- Click on the action menu (⋮) at the top right.
- Click on **Open kDrive Web** to access the files stored on the kDrive server.
- Click on the item above to open the **folder on your computer** containing your kDrive files. These files will be virtually present if [Lite Sync](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/lite%20sync) is enabled, meaning they are accessible without being fully downloaded.

For more details, refer to the [kDrive documentation](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2456/access-kdrive-files-locally-and-online).

question: How do I sync kDrive with my Synology NAS?
ground_truth: To sync kDrive with Synology NAS via WebDAV: Prerequisites: Synology NAS accessible from Internet, know your kDrive ID. Steps: 1) Log in to Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM). 2) Install Cloud Sync from Package Center if needed. 3) Open Cloud Sync. 4) Click + to add a Cloud. 5) Choose WebDAV. 6) Enter: Server address: https://[kDriveID].connect.kdrive.infomaniak.com, Username: Infomaniak email, Password: create an application password. 7) Select local folder, destination, and sync type: Bidirectional (changes in both directions), Download remote only (backup kDrive to NAS), or Download local only (backup NAS to kDrive).
key_points: Bidirectional, Download remote, or Download local sync
answer:
To sync kDrive with your Synology NAS, follow these steps:

1. Log in to the Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM).
2. If necessary, download and install the **Cloud Sync** app from the **Package Center.**
3. Open **Cloud Sync.**
4. Click on the **+** at the bottom left to add a Cloud.
5. Choose **WebDAV** at the bottom of the list of available Clouds:

6. For the account parameters, use the following information:
   - **Server address:** `https://IDkDrive.connect.kdrive.infomaniak.com` (replace `IDkDrive` with your kDrive identifier).
   - **Username:** Your email address to log in to the Infomaniak account.
   - **Password:** Create an application password for this specific use.
7. Select the local folder, destination, and desired synchronization type:
   - **Bidirectional:** Changes made will be reflected in both directions.
   - **Download only remote changes:** Ideal for saving a kDrive to your NAS.
   - **Download only local changes:** Ideal for saving data from your NAS to a kDrive.

Source: [Sync Synology with kDrive](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2404/sync-synology-with-kdrive)

question: How do I create a channel in kChat?
ground_truth: To create a channel in kChat: 1) Click the button in the left sidebar of kChat web app (ksuite.infomaniak.com/kchat). 2) Click 'Create a new channel'. 3) Set: A) Name (modifiable later), B) URL (lowercase, numbers, dots, dashes, underscores), C) Private or Public status, D) Description. Every Organization has a default 'General' channel for all users. Public channels are visible to all; Private channels require invitation. To convert public to private: click channel > chevron > Convert (permanent). To leave: chevron > Leave. To archive: chevron > Archive. Can also add to favorites, mute, or organize by categories.

question: What slash commands are available in kChat?
ground_truth: To use slash commands in kChat: 1) Click in the composition field. 2) Type / followed by the command. 3) Send. Typing just / shows available commands in a modal (like going offline). You can create custom slash commands: 1) Open kChat web or desktop app. 2) Click 'New' icon next to organization name. 3) Click 'Integrations'. 4) Click 'Slash command'. 5) Add a command with name, trigger, content type, and action. Custom commands can call external APIs or run scripts. Note: External users cannot see the Integrations menu.
answer:
Here are the available slash commands in kChat:

- `/away` - Set your status to away
- `/back` - Set your status to back
- `/dnd` - Set your status to do not disturb
- `/focus` - Set your status to focus
- `/help` - Display the help menu
- `/invite` - Invite a user to join a channel
- `/join` - Join a channel
- `/kick` - Remove a user from a channel
- `/leave` - Leave a channel
- `/mute` - Mute a channel
- `/pin` - Pin a message to a channel
- `/rename` - Rename a channel
- `/unpin` - Unpin a message from a channel
- `/unmute` - Unmute a channel

For more details, refer to the [kChat documentation](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2134/using-kchat-slash-commands).

question: How can I connect external applications to kChat?
ground_truth: To connect external apps to kChat using webhooks: 1) Open kChat web or desktop app. 2) Click 'New' icon next to organization name. 3) Click 'Integrations'. 4) Access webhook categories. For incoming webhooks (receive messages from external apps): 1) Click 'Incoming Webhooks'. 2) Add name and description. 3) Select destination channel. 4) Save to get URL. 5) External app sends POST request with JSON: {"text": "message"}. For outgoing webhooks: kChat sends info when events occur. Parameters include channel override, username, icon_url. Response includes message details. Add ?slack_return_format=true for Slack-style response.
key_points: Incoming webhooks receive from external apps
Outgoing webhooks send to external apps
POST request with JSON text field
answer:
To connect external applications to kChat, you can follow these steps:

- **Invite an external user to use kChat**:
  1. Access the kChat Web app or open the kChat desktop app.
  2. Click the button to invite members.
  3. Click the link to invite a new user.
  4. Specify the email address(es) of the person(s) to invite.
  5. Specify the channel(s) to which these people will have access.
  6. Click the blue button to send the invitation.
  7. The invited person receives an email with a link leading to the kChat interface and the channel shared with them.
  8. The invited user must complete the registration process to access kChat. [Read more](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2846/invite-an-external-user-to-use-kchat)

- **Join a kMeet meeting**:
  1. Start kMeet via [kmeet.infomaniak.com](https://kmeet.infomaniak.com) or from one of the applications for computer or mobile devices.
  2. Click the button to join a meeting.
  3. Enter the code for the meeting or its link.
  4. Click the OK button.
  5. Authorize access to your webcam and microphone from your browser or from one of the applications.
  6. Enter a pseudonym or your first and last name.
  7. Adjust the settings according to your preferences.
  8. Click the blue button to join the meeting.
  9. If necessary, enter the access password and/or encryption key provided by the meeting organizer. [Read more](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2473/join-a-kmeet-meeting)

- **Accept the invitation to use kChat**:
  1. The invited user receives the invitation to their email address and clicks on the Accept the invitation.
  2. They specify their contact details as well as the email address/password they wish to use and complete the registration.
  3. Once the registration is complete, the newly registered user can log in to their Manager and access kChat to which they have been invited.
  4. Existing users are automatically notified of the arrival of the new participant and can now converse with them. [Read more](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/1455/invite-a-user-to-use-kchat)

- **Secure a kMeet meeting with a password and encryption key**:
  1. Start kMeet via [kmeet.infomaniak.com](https://kmeet.infomaniak.com) or from one of the applications for computers or mobile devices.
  2. Start a new meeting.
  3. Enter a name for your meeting room.
  4. Click on the security options.
  5. Enable the toggle switch to protect access.
  6. Create the password.
  7. Continue to start the meeting.
  8. Specify the name you want to use as a participant in the meeting.
  9. Share the meeting link or code and the password with your participants. [Read more](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2464/secure-a-kmeet-meeting-with-a-password-and-encryption-key)

- **Manage emoticons and gifs on kChat**:
  1. To manage additional emoticons, click on this button of the emoji panel.
  2. Specify a name up to 64 characters.
  3. Specify a `.gif`, `.png`, or `.jpg` file for your emoticon.
  4. The emoticon can then be used by all kChat users of your Organization thanks to the unique name you have assigned to it. [Read more](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/1190/manage-emoticons-and-gifs-on-kchat)

question: How do I translate a message in kChat?
ground_truth: To translate a message in kChat: 1) Access kChat via ksuite.infomaniak.com/kchat, or the mobile app (iOS/Android), or desktop app (macOS/Windows/Linux). 2) View the message to translate. 3) Click the action menu (three dots) at the top right of the message. 4) Click 'Translate'. 5) The translated message appears below your conversation and is only visible to you. The translation is automatic into your own language.
key_points: click action menu (three dots) on message
answer:
To translate a message in kChat, follow these steps:

1. Open the kChat web app, mobile app, or desktop app.
2. View the message you want to translate.
3. Click on the action menu (three dots) at the top right of the message.
4. Select "Translate."
5. The translated message will appear below your conversation and will be visible only to you.

question: How can I invite external users to kChat?
ground_truth: To invite external users to kChat: Prerequisites: Be Organization administrator with full kChat rights. Steps: 1) Access kChat at ksuite.infomaniak.com/kchat or desktop app. 2) Click 'Invite members' button. 3) Click link to invite new user. 4) Enter email address(es). 5) Specify channel(s) they'll access. 6) Click send invitation. Invited users receive email with link to the channel. They must create Infomaniak account if needed. External users are not counted as regular users. Guests CAN: pin messages, use slash commands, add favorites, mute, update profile. Guests CANNOT: discover public channels, join open teams, create DMs with non-channel members, invite people.
key_points: external users not counted as users
answer:
To invite external users to kChat, follow these steps:

1. **Invite a user to use kChat**:
   - Go to the [Invite a user to use kChat](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/1455/invite-a-user-to-use-kchat) guide.
   - Follow the instructions to send an invitation to the external user.
   - The invitation will be pending until the user completes their registration.

2. **Accept the invitation**:
   - The invited user will receive an email with the invitation.
   - They need to click on **Accept the invitation** and complete the registration process by providing their contact details and setting up their email address and password.

3. **Invite an external user to use kChat**:
   - If you want to invite a completely external user who will not be counted as a kSuite user, follow the guide [Invite an external user to use kChat](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2846/invite-an-external-user-to-use-kchat).
   - The external user will be invited to create an Infomaniak account if they do not already have one.

For more detailed instructions, you can refer to the respective guides provided in the sources.

question: What is Euria and how do I use it in kChat?
ground_truth: Euria is the AI assistant available in kSuite/kChat. It can perform calculations, translations, provide information, and answer questions. To use: 1) In kChat left sidebar, use channel search (bots appear as channels) or click + next to Direct Messages. 2) Search for 'bot' or the bot name. 3) Add the bot with [bot] tag. 4) Create a private discussion with the bot (not a group conversation). 5) Write to it like chatting with a person. New users automatically receive a welcome message from Euria. For AI summaries of discussions, refer to the separate summary feature guide.
key_points: Euria is AI assistant in kSuite
search for bot in channel search
answer:
Euria is an artificial intelligence assistant available within Infomaniak's kSuite, particularly useful for summarizing discussions and acting as a conversational agent on kChat. Here’s how you can use Euria in kChat:

### Summarizing a Discussion
1. **Hover** over the message you want to summarize.
2. **Click** on the Euria actions icon in the top right.
3. **Select** "Summarize the discussion thread".
4. **View** the summary generated by Euria, which will be sent by kChat Bot in the right sidebar.

### Using Euria as a Conversational Agent
1. **Add Euria to your contacts** by searching for the bot in the left sidebar of kChat.
2. **Search** for the bot by using the channel search or the "+" icon next to "Direct Messages".
3. **Select** the bot labeled with the tag [bot] or search for the term "bot" or "chat".
4. **Start a private discussion** with Euria by creating a direct message channel.
5. **Interact** with Euria by typing your questions or requests as you would with any other contact.

For more detailed instructions, you can refer to the official guides:
- [Use Euria on kChat (summarize a discussion)](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2480/use-euria-on-kchat-summarize-a-discussion)
- [Use Euria on kChat (conversational agent)](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2840/use-euria-on-kchat-conversational-agent)
